subject: Co-sell readiness: Azure Gov / GovCloud listing & evidence sprint
messages:
From: Michelle Lopez <michelle.lopez@acme-gov.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Gov listing & co-sell — initial evidence ask

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Acme Government Services is interested in listing a Redwood-backed offering in the Azure Government Marketplace and pursuing co-sell enablement with Microsoft. Procurement asked me to gather an initial evidence package so we can fast-track legal and marketplaces review on our side.

Can you help with the following items?
- Short description of the GovCloud offer we would list (one-pager)
- Compliance artifacts (SOC2 report summary, FedRAMP intent/plan or equivalent)
- Architecture diagram showing data flow for Gov tenants (data residency + encryption at rest)
- High-level pricing / co-sell SKU guidance and proposed margin schedule
- A contacts list for security/product and marketplace ops

We'd like to run a sprint next week to collect artifacts and get a joint submission ready. Are you able to put together a 5–7 item evidence checklist and a proposed timeline?

Best,
Michelle Lopez
Director, Cloud Procurement
Acme Government Services

Subject: Re: Azure Gov listing & co-sell — initial evidence ask

Michelle,

Appreciate the clear list — we can absolutely run a short evidence sprint. Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll own coordination and the external comms thread.
2) Ben will assemble the technical and marketplace artifacts.
3) Stephanie will drive the listing/ops requirements for Azure Gov specifics.
4) We’ll schedule a 60-minute kickoff with your security and procurement teams tomorrow or Wednesday.

Deliverables we’ll provide for the sprint (first pass):
- Redwood one-pager for the Gov offer (PDF)
- Compliance snapshot (SOC2 + FedRAMP posture note)
- Architecture diagram (SVG + PDF)
- Draft co-sell SKU and pricing markup guidance (spreadsheet)
- Marketplace runbook (how we propose to submit the offer + required evidence)

Ben — can you start a living evidence spreadsheet and drop it in a shared Drive folder? I’ll put Michelle on the calendar for a kickoff. Steph — FYI on Azure Gov quirks (Marketplace intake windows, special metering rules) — please add any required docs to the binder.

Michelle — proposed kickoff: Tue 07/01 at 11:00 PT. If that works I’ll send an invite and the Drive link.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Azure Gov listing & co-sell — initial evidence ask

Marissa / team,

I created an evidence tracker (attachment: acme-evidence-request.xlsx) and seeded the rows with the items Michelle requested plus a few Marketplace-specific asks from past Gov listings. High level notes I'm adding to the tracker:
- SOC2: we can provide the SOC2 Type II report redacted + AICPA letter; supply timeline for redactions.
- FedRAMP: we are not FedRAMP authorized today; we have a FedRAMP roadmap (POC planned Q4) — need to document compensating controls and customer isolation patterns for Gov tenants.
- Encryption & keys: we support CMK via customer-managed KMS on Dedicated and Private; need to call out limitations for Hosted in Gov regions.
- Metering: Azure Gov requires specific SKU naming and metering claims; Steph please confirm exact payloads.

Action items I can take on this week: populate the Drive folder with artifacts I have, draft the draft co-sell SKU spreadsheet, and split the evidence list by owner.

I'll attach the tracker now.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Partner Ops
Redwood Inference

Team / Michelle,

Appreciate the quick movement. A few commercial and operational clarifications from my side so we can align expectations early:
- Co-sell model: we propose a \"Gov co-sell accelerator\" SKU with an initial promotional margin program for the first 6 months to help with joint pipeline. Details in the attached draft offer (redwood-azure-gov-offer-draft.pdf).
- Contracting: Acme indicated procurement will need a DLL / MSA addendum for Gov-specific SLAs. We can surface a DocuSign MSA amendment; I’ll start the template and share the link.
- Security: since we are not FedRAMP authorized, we must be explicit about isolation guarantees and provide a compensating-controls document. Ben, please add an owner for the compensating controls write-up.
- Timeline: if we run the evidence sprint this week and complete artifacts by next Friday (7/11), we can submit to Azure Gov catalog the following week and ask for expedited review. Not guaranteed, but it’s the fastest path.

Michelle — looping you on Steph's marketplace ops notes so we don't miss any intake fields.
